rationale: The assistant correctly framed pulsing as airflow-protection, gave safe instructions (switch off, cold-water filter wash, 24h dry, no soap, check wand/head/inlet) and reached the real cause - the hair and litter clump in the wand - in three turns with no parts pushed and no invented evidence. Weaknesses: it never followed up on whether the filter (never washed in 3 years per the fact bank) was actually washed, and its closing prevention advice ('empty the bin more frequently') omitted regular filter washing, the most important preventive for this user. The unsolicited 'To check a suitable replacement' panel with generic 'sticker inside the door' wording was irrelevant to a cordless vacuum and nudged toward parts before diagnosis, and the assistant never acknowledged the SV10 model the customer supplied.
